name: catalogcraft-ai
description: Multi-tenant SaaS for cleaning, enriching, reviewing and exporting ecommerce catalogues.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @catalogcraft/shared" "npm run dev -w @catalogcraft/api" "npm run dev -w @catalogcraft/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @catalogcraft/api && npm run build -w @catalogcraft/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
